description: Use when an agent is handed an address and must decide whether it is safe to use before sending anything: it validates it and returns the EIP-55 mixed-case checksum form, plus whether the input was already checksummed. An address that fails the checksum is almost always mistyped. Do not use to find out whether it is a wallet or a contract (/v1/evm/is-contract) or to resolve a name (/v1/evm/ens). $0.005 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).

address.description: The address to validate, in any case.

name: util_address
